goal-store.excerpt:
pub async fn replace_thread_goal_snapshot(
        &self,
        goal: &crate::ThreadGoal,
    ) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
        let mut transaction = self.pool.begin_immediate().await?;
        sqlx::query(
            r#"
INSERT INTO thread_goals (
    thread_id,
    goal_id,
    objective,
    status,
    token_budget,
    tokens_used,
    time_used_seconds,
    created_at_ms,
    updated_at_ms
) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
ON CONFLICT(thread_id) DO UPDATE SET
    goal_id = excluded.goal_id,
    objective = excluded.objective,
    status = excluded.status,
    token_budget = excluded.token_budget,
    tokens_used = excluded.tokens_used,
    time_used_seconds = excluded.time_used_seconds,
    created_at_ms = excluded.created_at_ms,
    updated_at_ms = excluded.updated_at_ms
            "#,
        )
        .bind(goal.thread_id.to_string())
        .bind(&goal.goal_id)
        .bind(&goal.objective)
        .bind(goal.status.as_str())
        .bind(goal.token_budget)
        .bind(goal.tokens_used)
        .bind(goal.time_used_seconds)
        .bind(datetime_to_epoch_millis(goal.created_at))
        .bind(datetime_to_epoch_millis(goal.updated_at))

cvg-safety.excerpt:
- Seguir `DISCOVERY -> PRD -> SPEC -> BUILD -> AUDIT`.
- Nao iniciar codigo sem gate aprovado e task registrada.
- Nao usar dados reais.
- Nao liberar producao irrestrita.
- Nao confirmar, cancelar ou reagendar consulta real automaticamente.
- Nao responder RAG sem fonte institucional aprovada.
- Nao executar acao clinica, financeira ou prontuario definitivo.
- Toda acao sensivel exige approval ou handoff.
- Ao final de qualquer rodada, atualizar runtime state, execution log, backlog quando aplicavel e evidencias.

source_checksum_verification.method: Each cited upstream file read as bytes and compared byte-for-byte to git show <pin>:<path>; spans use 1-based inclusive lines with original line endings; all input pointers/raw axes and case digests checked. This is integrity validation, not approval.

configuration.verification: Exact key-set match with frozen matrix and pinned source schema; nested semantics OPEN.

methods.limit: Preserved full matrix domain, including internal/experimental and both directions; eligibility/reachability/default/type expansion OPEN. Not all are ClientRequests.

expansion_domains.python: NotificationPayload has generated known payloads plus RawResponseItemCompletedNotification and UnknownNotification. Python generated/sync/async type domains remain separate OPEN expansions; TS unions do not qualify Python.

historical_record.detail: High-level Python sync/async signatures, context lifecycle, turn handles, login handles, ExternalMessage, retries and errors need language-specific future variants; TS34 is insufficient.
Direct and transitive RPC bindings are source partial; generic method names, approvals, goals, subscription races/cancellation, overload and transport failures need concrete oracles.
All generated classes/fields/aliases/default expressions inventoried; Pydantic runtime behavior/inherited methods, generator normalization and schema equivalence unverified.
SDK 0.0.0-dev / dependency runtime 0.153.4 / minimum 0.151.0 / Git source pin are different identities; no binary/wheel inspected, downloaded or executed. No manifest-only provenance authentication.
Original 34 AST export records preserved and source-bound; regex binding is not TypeScript typechecking or runtime qualification. Abort/JSONL/exec cleanup variants remain mandatory.
OS/arch/wheel/package manager/vendor fallback/install/authenticated artifacts and proxy wrapper behavior need functional qualification; developer helpers do not count as product APIs.
